keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! LASK 1, Slovan Bratislava 0. Kasper Jørgensen (LASK) header from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Moses Usor with a cross following a corner.
Cristian Martínez (Slovan Bratislava) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Samuel Kozlovsky (Slovan Bratislava).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Suleiman Camara (Slovan Bratislava).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Kevin Wimmer (Slovan Bratislava) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Nino Marcelli replaces Suleiman Camara because of an injury.
Goal! LASK 2, Slovan Bratislava 0. Kasper Jørgensen (LASK) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Goal! LASK 3, Slovan Bratislava 0. Robert Ljubicic (LASK) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner following a corner.
First Half ends, LASK 3, Slovan Bratislava 0.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Sandro Cruz replaces Kevin Wimmer.
Second Half begins LASK 3, Slovan Bratislava 0.
Goal! LASK 4, Slovan Bratislava 0. Samuel Adeniran (LASK) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Sascha Horvath following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury Svetozar Markovic (Slovan Bratislava).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, LASK. Daniel Elfadli replaces Xavier Mbuyamba.
Substitution, LASK. Krystof Danek replaces Robert Ljubicic.
Substitution, LASK. Sasa Kalajdzic replaces Samuel Adeniran.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Leo Hofstädter replaces Alexej Maros.
Delay in match because of an injury Moses Usor (LASK).
Substitution, LASK. Christoph Lang replaces Moses Usor because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Tigran Barseghyan replaces Andraz Sporar.
Substitution, Slovan Bratislava. Peter Pokorny replaces Cristian Martínez.
Substitution, LASK. Alessandro Schöpf replaces Sascha Horvath.
